snippet.title: Chained Echoes: Ashes of Elrant - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ashes of Elrant is the official Story DLC for the award winning Chained Echoes. Get yourself ready for a new playable character - the White Wolf, visit new areas, fight over 40 new monsters and bosses and listen to 15 new tracks by mastermind Eddie Marianukroh.

Ashes of Elrant will release 7th of August on all platforms.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350260
Twitter: https://x.com/ChainedEchoes
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/chainedechoes.bsky.social
